text:
maria: Heads up — saw a couple of production incidents during a scale-down of the statefulset for redis-workers. Pods got stuck Terminating while volumes were detaching, which caused a short window of increased latency for jobs. Wondering if we should change the rollout strategy + add a preStop hook to drain connections before kube evicts the pod.

ajay: Ugh. Seen that with EBS detach + long IO. Do you know if the stuck ones were on the same node or spread?

maria: Spread across nodes. Logs show kubelet waiting on device detach for ~70s. PVCs are RWO (aws-ebs). Cluster autoscaler was also trimming nodes, so timing may be rough.

linh: We use a StatefulSet with rollingUpdate and partition controlled by our deploy pipeline. Could we use PodDisruptionBudget + a preStop that stops accepting new jobs and waits for in-flight jobs to finish? That should avoid in-progress work being interrupted.

maria: That's my thought too. Proposed changes:
- Add a small preStop script to call /internal/drain and sleep up to 60s
- Make PDB minAvailable: 1 (so we never take all replicas down during maintenance)
- Adjust rollingUpdate maxUnavailable: 1 and maybe bump replicas by +1 during rollout windows

sam: +1 on preStop. Also we should ensure the drain endpoint respects a deadline and signals readiness probe until finished, e.g.:

```
# preStop example
exec:
  command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "curl -sfS http://127.0.0.1:8080/internal/drain || true; sleep 60"]
```

ajay: For terraform/infra side, changing the StatefulSet spec is just k8s. But if we want to temporarily bump replicas for safer rolling deploys we could add an optional tf variable that CI flips when doing cluster-critical upgrades. E.g. `redis_workers_replicas_delta` default 0.

linh: Would rather avoid adding too many ad-hoc TF variables. Maybe the deploy job can patch the sts before rollout: `kubectl scale sts/redis-workers --replicas=$((current+1))` then rollout, then scale back.

maria: I'm going to open a small PR with these changes to the manifest and add a runbook entry for scaling in the ops docs. Will also add a note to the deploy job to optionally bump replicas.

infra-bot: Deploy job started for redis-workers/staging (run id: ci-4521) :gear:

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/k8s-configs/pull/718 — includes preStop, PDB tweak, and a README note. Needs reviewers @ajay @linh.

ajay: Reviewing now. Quick thought: if we add preStop + readiness toggle, make sure the readiness probe path is the same service that frontends check, otherwise we could have a period where node still in endpoints but not ready.

tess: Also double-check metrics/alerting — add a tiny alert for stuck terminating pods > 60s so oncall is aware before user impact.

maria: Good call. I'll add an alert rule and the runbook step to check node drain progress.

sam: FYI, for on-prem customers we've seen kernel-level volume detach delays. If we start seeing more than 30s consistently we should consider increasing attach/detach timeouts in the CSI driver or moving to ReadWriteMany (if app supports it).

maria: Agreed. For now we'll proceed with preStop + PDB + small deploy bump. If we see repeated events we'll iterate. Thanks all — I'll tag when PR is ready and assign to @ajay for final. :thumbsup:
